SALES_COMPARISON._Comment:
See attached addenda. Copilot said:
The borrower provided a list of sales that were reviewed and analyzed during the appraisal process. While these sales were considered, they were not deemed the most comparable indicators of value for the subject property and, therefore, were not utilized in the final sales comparison approach. The sales selected for inclusion in the report were considered more representative of the subject's competitive market segment with respect to location, physical characteristics, condition, utility, and overall market appeal. The borrower-provided sales were retained and analyzed as part of the appraisal process; however, the appraiser concluded that the selected comparable sales provided a more reliable basis for value estimation. The MLS sheets for both the comparable sales utilized in the report and the additional sales provided by the borrower are attached to the appraisal report for review.

PRIOR_SALE.GSEPriorSaleComment:
See attached addenda. Copilot said:
CoreLogic public records indicate the subject transferred multiple times within the past three years. The most recent transfer occurred on February 6, 2026, by Limited Warranty Deed (Doc. #12360-354), recorded February 10, 2026. An additional Limited Warranty Deed was also recorded on February 10, 2026 (Doc. #12360-351) related to a February 6, 2026 transfer. Prior transfers include an Administrator's Deed dated August 21, 2025 (Doc. #12235-27), recorded August 22, 2025, and an Administrator's Deed dated October 11, 2024 (Doc. #11990-176), recorded October 23, 2024. These transfers appear to be related to estate administration and subsequent conveyances rather than open-market arm's-length sales.
Information provided by the borrower indicates the property underwent substantial renovations following acquisition, with documented rehabilitation investments totaling approximately $59,000. Reported improvements include a new HVAC system, basement flooring, interior and exterior updates, kitchen and bathroom improvements, paint, lighting, and additional rent-ready repairs.
